CHAPTER 01
Overview

Description: In 2024, the e-commerce market size in Russia increased by 39 percent year-over-year, having exceeded 11 trillion Russian rubles. A steadily expanding market, Russian e-commerce experienced a particularly accelerated growth over the past years, and
the coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic contributed significantly to its growth. In 2026, the market size was forecast to reach 16.8 trillion Russian rubles. Read more
Note(s): Russia; 2019 to 2024; *Forecast. The statistic has been compiled using several reports by the source. Read more
Source(s): Boxberry; Data Insight (RU); GBS Broker; Logsis; Various sources (Intensa, SalesFinder)
